name: steward
displayName: Steward · 长期维护型研发团队
description: Steward（长期维护型研发团队）：主代理作为 Tech Lead，按任务 DAG 与文件所有权派发 PM、架构师、前后端工程师、QA、浏览器验收员与代码评审员，当前覆盖功能交付；可选 GenUI 视图呈现任务 DAG 与缺陷看板。Bug 修复、维护循环、接手存量项目见路线图。A role-based engineering team plugin: the current release covers feature delivery, with optional GenUI views of the task DAG and defect triage; bug fixing, maintenance, and takeover are on the roadmap.
author: Lin
